SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_week, MIN(calendar_date) mn, MAX(calendar_date) mx, COUNT(*) n, MIN(fiscal_period) p, MAX(fiscal_period) p2
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND fiscal_period=2 GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, COUNT(*) lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) dist_rl, MIN(f.sale_date), MAX(f.sale_date)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) net_sales,
  SUM(CASE WHEN n.store_id=900 THEN n.net_sales END) web
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(r.net_sales) rpt_net, SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns) rpt_gross, SUM(r.returns_net) rpt_ret, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT r.store_id) stores, SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id=900 THEN r.net_sales END) rpt_web, SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id=999 THEN r.net_sales END) rpt_999
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT s.store_id, o.status, COUNT(*) lines, MIN(f.sale_date), MAX(f.sale_date), SUM(f.net_amount) net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-05-01' AND DATE '2026-07-05' AND (s.store_id IN (900,999) OR o.web_order_id IS NOT NULL OR f.channel_code='WB')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.calendar_date, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.holiday_name, d.is_trading_day FROM dim_date d
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27','FY2025/26') AND NOT d.is_trading_day ORDER BY 1

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
weekly AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n
    JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period = 2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2026/27', 'FY2025/26')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT ty.fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week,
       ROUND(ty.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_this_year, ROUND(ly.net_sales, 2) AS net_sales_last_year,
       ROUND(100.0 * (ty.net_sales / ly.net_sales - 1), 1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty
JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week = ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27'
ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
